stem: Which statement correctly summarizes the reason for this speech?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: Axis violations of international law caused the United States to hold criminal trials.

options.label: G
options.text: German expansion in Western Europe caused the United States to assist France.

options.label: H
options.text: Japanese aggression in the Pacific caused the United States to declare war.

options.label: J
options.text: Allied defeats on the battlefield caused the United States to develop new weapons.

visual_elements:
Yesterday, December 7, 1941—a date which will live in infamy—the United States of America was suddenly and deliberately attacked. . . .

—President Franklin D. Roosevelt, address to Congress, December 8, 1941
